BiblicalUsage: Chozeba appears once, in the genealogy of Judah in 1 Chronicles 4:22, among the men of Chozeba and the ancient things of that family line. It was a city in Judah, and its name means falsehood.
TheologicalSignificance: For me, even a one-line town in a genealogy has its place: the record keeps the names, and God keeps the people.
